12.0.en: One silent [[funeral:funeral]] ended near a mossy [[grave:grave]] behind the white poplars.
12.0.zh: 一场寂静的葬礼，在白杨后长满苔藓的坟墓旁结束。

12.1.en: A [[plain:plain]] [[tomb:tomb]] stands far from the noisy [[hell:hell]] of those smoky old fields.
12.1.zh: 朴素的坟墓远离硝烟弥漫的旧战场那喧闹的地狱。

12.2.en: Old [[maritime:maritime]] maps show the [[naval:naval]] routes once used by worried sailors.
12.2.zh: 古老的海事地图上，标着忧心的水手们曾走过的海军航线。

12.3.en: A [[quiet:quiet]] [[fleet:fleet]] sleeps offshore, while a tired [[troop:troop]] rests among the green pines.
12.3.zh: 安静的舰队在近海沉睡，疲惫的部队在绿松间休整。

12.4.en: No [[rough:rough]] [[landing:landing]] shakes the cove where gulls [[hover:hover]] over blue waves.
12.4.zh: 没有猛烈的抢滩惊扰小海湾，海鸥在蓝色浪涛上盘旋。

12.5.en: Slow walkers [[proceed:proceed]] along the stone steps as peace [[progress:progresses]] in every heart.
12.5.zh: 行人沿石阶缓缓前行，和平在每个人心中生长。

13.0.en: No [[military:military]] [[truck:truck]] carries [[nuclear:nuclear]] loads through the blossoming apple orchards.
13.0.zh: 没有军用卡车载着核货物穿过盛开的苹果园。

13.1.en: [[bitter:Bitter]] [[poison:poison]] cannot [[devastate:devastate]] the gardens where children plant young saplings.
13.1.zh: 在孩子们栽种幼苗的园子里，苦味的毒药也无法肆虐。

13.2.en: Each needless [[risk:risk]] steals the calm joy of [[adventure:adventure]] from curious young travellers.
13.2.zh: 每次不必要的冒险，都在偷走好奇旅人从容的乐趣。

13.3.en: Sudden [[peril:peril]] may foretell [[catastrophe:catastrophe]] for towns that ignore the early signs.
13.3.zh: 对无视早期征兆的村镇，突如其来的危险可能预示灾难。

13.4.en: Old bridges need not [[collapse:collapse]] under the [[torture:torture]] of the long rainy seasons.
13.4.zh: 古桥不必在漫长雨季的折磨下倒塌。

13.5.en: [[cruel:Cruel]] words [[humiliate:humiliate]] playmates, and lies [[can:can]] [[damage:damage]] young friendships.
13.5.zh: 狠心的话会让伙伴蒙羞，谎言也会伤害幼小的友谊。

14.0.en: Such [[harmful:harmful]] jokes [[mislead:mislead]] newcomers and [[spoil:spoil]] the [[quiet:quiet]] evening classes.
14.0.zh: 这种有害的玩笑误导新人，还搅扰了安静的晚课。

14.1.en: Loud quarrels [[disturb:disturb]] sleepy minds, and boastful shouts [[interfere:interfere]] with the lessons.
14.1.zh: 大声争吵打扰困倦的人，自夸的喊叫干扰上课。

14.2.en: Late bells [[interrupt:interrupt]] the games, but kind children never [[retreat:retreat]] from their [[duty:duty]].
14.2.zh: 迟来的钟声打断了游戏，但好孩子从不逃避自己的职责。

14.3.en: Dry leaves [[shrink:shrink]] in the sun, and tired feet [[withdraw:withdraw]] from the dusty roads.
14.3.zh: 干叶在阳光下收缩，疲惫的双脚从尘土路上退回。

14.4.en: Frail elders [[withstand:withstand]] the cold winds through firm [[compromise:compromise]] among neighbours.
14.4.zh: 体弱的老人靠邻里间坚定的互谅互让，抵御住寒风。

14.5.en: Tired hands [[surrender:surrender]] their knives, while white doves [[escape:escape]] into the clouds.
14.5.zh: 疲惫的手放下刀具，白鸽飞向云间。

15.0.en: Sleepy clerks [[quit:quit]] their quarrels, and leaders [[abandon:abandon]] pride for warm handshakes.
15.0.zh: 困倦的职员停止争吵，领袖们放下骄傲，热情握手。

15.1.en: We gladly [[forgo:forgo]] harsh slogans and [[discard:discard]] the faded posters of old days.
15.1.zh: 我们欣然舍弃严苛的口号，丢弃旧日褪色的海报。

15.2.en: Clean yards are [[rid:rid]] of weeds, and children [[defend:defend]] the blossoms with care.
15.2.zh: 干净的院子清除了杂草，孩子们细心守护着花朵。

15.3.en: Stone walls [[safeguard:safeguard]] the seeds, and [[gentle:gentle]] love will [[defeat:defeat]] cold mistrust.
15.3.zh: 石墙守护种子，温柔的爱终将战胜冰冷的猜疑。

15.4.en: [[gentle:Gentle]] hands [[resist:resist]] anger, and letters [[capture:capture]] the smiles of distant cousins.
15.4.zh: 温柔的手压住怒气，书信留住远方表亲的笑颜。

15.5.en: True [[victory:victory]] brings [[quiet:quiet]] [[triumph:triumph]] to simple homes and sunny schools.
15.5.zh: 真正的胜利把安宁的凯旋带给简朴人家和阳光校园。

16.0.en: Kind hearts [[conquer:conquer]] fear where a white [[monument:monument]] holds its silent names.
16.0.zh: 白色纪念碑上刻着沉默的名字，善良的心在那里战胜恐惧。

16.1.en: A grey [[tablet:tablet]] stands beside a tall [[statue:statue]] in the shady courtyard.
16.1.zh: 绿荫庭院里，灰色石碑立在高大的雕像旁。

16.2.en: A [[bronze:bronze]] [[medal:medal]] keeps high [[honour:honour]] for the nurses of wartime winters.
16.2.zh: 一枚铜质奖章，为战时寒冬里的护士们守护着崇高荣誉。

16.3.en: Their [[glorious:glorious]] deeds [[contribute:contribute]] light to the clear autumn classrooms each year.
16.3.zh: 他们光荣的事迹，年年为明朗的秋日教室添一份光亮。

16.4.en: Old friends [[devote:devote]] their evenings and [[owe:owe]] warm thanks to the nameless helpers.
16.4.zh: 老朋友们奉献出夜晚，把由衷的感谢献给无名的帮手。

16.5.en: [[night:Night]] [[patrol:patrols]] have turned into friendly watchers of the sleepy village lanes.
16.5.zh: 夜间巡逻变成了守望沉睡村巷的友好护卫。

17.0.en: Among the blooming peony bushes, faded [[camouflage:camouflage]] now hides no [[obstacle:obstacle]].
17.0.zh: 盛开的牡丹丛中，褪色的伪装再也遮不住什么障碍。

17.1.en: Deep [[burrow:burrows]] [[shelter:shelter]] the rabbits, and no crafty [[spy:spy]] walks at [[midnight:midnight]].
17.1.zh: 深深的地洞庇护着兔子，午夜里再没有狡猾的间谍出没。

17.2.en: Young [[scout:scouts]] follow the paths where one kind [[general:general]] shares warm bread.
17.2.zh: 年轻的侦察员沿着小路走去，和善的将军在那里分发热面包。

17.3.en: A tired [[soldier:soldier]] rests beside a stately [[veteran:veteran]] under the maple trees.
17.3.zh: 枫树下，疲惫的士兵靠着一位威严的老兵休息。

18.0.en: Our small town [[polytechnic:polytechnic]] asked a kind [[mechanic:mechanic]] to guide the students today.
18.0.zh: 今天，镇上的小理工学院请来一位和善的机修工指导学生。

18.1.en: They wanted real [[advance:advance]] and hoped the students could [[innovate:innovate]] for cleaner streets.
18.1.zh: 他们想要真正的进步，盼着学生能为更洁净的街道创新。

18.2.en: Nobody expected a big [[breakthrough:breakthrough]] from a tiny [[gizmo:gizmo]] made in a backyard.
18.2.zh: 谁也没料到，后院里做的小玩意会带来大突破。

18.3.en: A friendly [[clerk:clerk]] explained [[patent:patents]] and showed the students how to [[invent:invent]] safely.
18.3.zh: 一位友好的职员讲解了专利，教学生如何安全地搞发明。

18.4.en: The team would not [[disclose:disclose]] their plans early, but would [[reveal:reveal]] them at the fair.
18.4.zh: 团队不打算提前透露计划，要留到集市上再揭晓。

18.5.en: They hoped the judges [[might:might]] [[uncover:uncover]] bright ideas and never coldly [[expose:expose]] weak points.
18.5.zh: 他们希望评委能发掘出闪光的点子，而不是冷漠地揭短。

19.0.en: The old sea man chose a water [[domain:domain]] from the blue [[realm:realm]] he knew so well.
19.0.zh: 老海员从自己熟悉的蓝色王国里，选定了用水这个领域。

19.1.en: A small green [[foundation:foundation]] paid for the work, and the students [[specialise:specialised]] in cleaning water.
19.1.zh: 一家小型绿色基金会出资支持，学生们专门研究净水。

19.2.en: They would [[concentrate:concentrate]] each noon and [[utilise:utilise]] the rain jars behind the school.
19.2.zh: 他们每天中午聚在一起，利用学校后面的雨水罐。

19.3.en: Daily [[usage:usage]] stayed simple, so a shy [[tester:tester]] wrote notes after each [[trial:trial]].
19.3.zh: 日常使用很简单，害羞的测试员每次试验后都做记录。

19.4.en: Their very [[first:first]] [[device:device]] joined a [[kitchen:kitchen]] [[appliance:appliance]] to save water for plants.
19.4.zh: 他们的第一个装置与厨房电器相连，为浇植物省水。

19.5.en: The school yard offered free [[facility:facilities]] and shared [[equipment:equipment]] for the evening work.
19.5.zh: 校园免费提供场地设施，晚上大家共用设备干活。

20.0.en: Each sharp [[instrument:instrument]] and hand [[tool:tool]] stayed locked inside a [[wooden:wooden]] box.
20.0.zh: 每件锋利的仪器和手工工具都锁在木箱里。

20.1.en: A [[brass:brass]] [[gauge:gauge]] helped the students [[measure:measure]] the [[muddy:muddy]] water with [[steady:steady]] hands.
20.1.zh: 黄铜量规帮学生们稳稳地测量浑浊的水样。

20.2.en: They would [[calculate:calculate]] the drops saved and [[compute:compute]] the costs on [[paper:paper]] after [[supper:supper]].
20.2.zh: 晚饭后，他们在纸上计算省下的水滴，核算费用。

20.3.en: They could [[count:count]] the jars emptied and [[estimate:estimate]] the savings for the whole street.
20.3.zh: 他们能数清用空的罐子，估算出整条街的节水量。

20.4.en: Teachers came to [[assess:assess]] the build and [[evaluate:evaluate]] the drawings with kind smiles.
20.4.zh: 老师们带着和善的笑容来评估作品、点评图纸。

20.5.en: A [[spare:spare]] [[accessory:accessory]] came free, with a clean [[byproduct:byproduct]] for the garden soil.
20.5.zh: 一个备用配件是白送的，还带来可肥花园土壤的干净副产品。

21.0.en: An [[auxiliary:auxiliary]] [[tube:tube]] made the build more [[versatile:versatile]] for small homes.
21.0.zh: 一根辅助管让这个装置更百搭，适合小户人家。

21.1.en: The students would [[accumulate:accumulate]] old bottles and [[attach:attach]] them with strong [[string:string]] lines.
21.1.zh: 学生们攒下旧瓶子，用结实的细绳把它们系好。

21.2.en: These glass jars [[belong:belong]] to the school lab that studies light and [[optics:optics]].
21.2.zh: 这些玻璃罐属于学校研究光与光学的实验室。

21.3.en: A school [[microscope:microscope]] showed the [[dirt:dirt]] clearly through its curved [[lens:lens]] at noon.
21.3.zh: 正午亮光下，学校显微镜透过弧形镜片把污垢照得清清楚楚。

21.4.en: A toy [[radar:radar]] beeped softly, and its faint [[echo:echo]] amused the children by the [[fence:fence]].
21.4.zh: 玩具雷达轻轻作响，微弱的回声逗乐了篱笆边的孩子。

21.5.en: A small [[sensor:sensor]] sent signals to a [[plain:plain]] [[multimedia:multimedia]] screen for everyone to see.
21.5.zh: 小传感器把信号发到朴素的多媒体屏幕上，人人都能看到。

22.0.en: A safe [[network:network]] linked the rooms, and a [[round:round]] [[dial:dial]] set the water flow.
22.0.zh: 安全的网络连通各个房间，圆形刻度盘调节着水流。

22.1.en: A borrowed [[laptop:laptop]] recorded the charts, while a big [[loudspeaker:loudspeaker]] called the breaks.
22.1.zh: 借来的笔记本电脑记录图表，大喇叭通知休息时间。

22.2.en: A cheap [[microphone:microphone]] caught the voices near an old [[cassette:cassette]] box of songs.
22.2.zh: 便宜的麦克风录下人声，旁边是装满歌曲的旧磁带盒。

22.3.en: Sticky [[tape:tape]] held the wires [[tight:tight]], and [[binary:binary]] code blinked on the tiny screen.
22.3.zh: 胶带把电线粘得牢牢的，二进制代码在小屏幕上闪烁。

22.4.en: A [[wireless:wireless]] link worked well, sending [[high-definition:high-definition]] pictures of the [[pond:pond]].
22.4.zh: 无线连接运转良好，传回池塘的高清画面。

22.5.en: Clear [[audio:audio]] helped everyone hear, and a shared [[vision:vision]] kept the team brave and calm.
22.5.zh: 清晰的音频让大家听得真切，共同的愿景让团队勇敢又镇定。

23.0.en: Their [[fantasy:fantasy]] grew wild, like happy [[science fiction:Science fiction]] about clean rivers.
23.0.zh: 他们的幻想天马行空，像关于清澈河流的快乐科幻故事。

23.1.en: A hand [[pump:pump]] lifted [[pond:pond]] water, while a tiny [[generator:generator]] lit a small lamp.
23.1.zh: 手压泵抽起池水，小发电机点亮一盏小灯。

23.2.en: Each [[plastic:plastic]] [[gear:gear]] held firm, and the base could [[pivot:pivot]] toward the sun.
23.2.zh: 每个塑料齿轮都咬合牢固，底座还能朝太阳转动。

23.3.en: No [[hydraulic:hydraulic]] oil leaked, and the school [[drainage:drainage]] stayed dry all week.
23.3.zh: 液压油一滴不漏，学校的排水沟整周干爽。

23.4.en: Dirty [[sewage:sewage]] stayed apart, and fresh [[ventilation:ventilation]] kept the [[shed:shed]] sweet.
23.4.zh: 污水分开存放，清新的通风让小棚气味干净。

23.5.en: Wet leaves would be [[compress:compressed]], and steam would [[condense:condense]] on the cold lids.
23.5.zh: 湿叶会被压缩，蒸汽则在冰冷的盖子上冷凝。

paraZh.12: 白杨后葬礼静穆，航线犹存，舰队安眠，和平悄然生长。
paraZh.13: 军车不扰果园毒药难毁花园，险情预示灾难，恶语伤友谊。
paraZh.14: 玩笑误导晚课受扰，孩子不退缩；放下刀具，白鸽入云。
paraZh.15: 止吵弃口号除杂草，善意胜猜疑，书信留笑迎凯旋。
paraZh.16: 碑石像旁荣誉长存，护士事迹添光，夜巡化作友好守望。
paraZh.17: 牡丹丛中伪装褪色，地洞藏兔，将军分粮，士兵傍老兵歇。
paraZh.18: 理工学院请机修工指导创新，专利讲解后留待集市揭晓。
paraZh.19: 老海员选定用水课题，基金会资助，学生专攻雨水利用。
paraZh.20: 仪器锁箱量规测水，晚饭后算账估算，老师微笑来评估。
paraZh.21: 辅助管增功能，瓶罐细绳搭装置，显微镜雷达传感器齐上阵。
paraZh.22: 网络连通刻度盘调水，电脑喇叭磁带齐全，高清看池塘。
paraZh.23: 幻想如科幻奔放，泵抽水灯点亮，齿轮牢固排水干爽。
